entity.name: Dubai air taxi price — what is confirmed
entity.meta_description: No fare has been announced for Dubai's air taxi as of August 2026. The RTA says pricing is undecided — 'cheaper than helicopters', aiming at Uber/Careem parity over time. The AED 350 figure circulating online is unsourced.
